He also congratulated electors from Assam, Kerala, Puducherry, Tamil Nadu, and West Bengal for their historic participation in recent Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: D.K. Shivakumar meets Governor Gehlot, stakes claim to form new govt in Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, the newly elected leader of the **Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee**, will be sworn in as Chief Minister on Wednesday, June 3rd at Lok Bhavan. The event is expected to be attended by the central leadership of the party and Governor Thaawarchand Gehlot has invited him to take the oath at 4:05 p.m.  The power transition was overseen by **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and **Sonia Gandhi**.  With Cabinet formation still under discussion, speculation remains about whether a full Cabinet will be sworn in and if there will be deputy Chief Ministers.

recent_articles.title: Is Melania Trump an 'alien'? Indian-origin attorney says White House's immigrant-bashing crosses line - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Reddy**, an Indian-origin immigration attorney, criticized the use of the word "alien" by **the White House**, arguing that it is dehumanizing and fuels negative perceptions.  He pointed out that while the term is legal in immigration law, its usage by the White House creates a narrative that paints lawful immigrants as outsiders. Reddy questioned if **Melania Trump**, who was born in Slovenia, is also an alien, highlighting the hypocrisy of using such language when the President's own family has a history of immigration.

recent_articles.title: Revival of Sabari rail project raises hopes in Central Travancore - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Sabari rail project**, a key rail link connecting Kerala's eastern high ranges and improving access for Sabarimala pilgrims, is showing signs of revival.  After decades of uncertainty and delays, the **State government** is considering reopening land acquisition offices and resuming field survey work on the 70-km stretch of proposed alignment. The project has also received a boost with the Railways initiating steps to examine the feasibility of establishing a cargo terminal at the proposed Thodupuzha station.  This renewed activity follows the State Cabinet's decision earlier this year to bear 50% of the estimated cost of Rs.3,800 crore for land acquisition and project completion. The project was sanctioned in 1997-98 but faced prolonged disputes over cost sharing and alignment issues.

recent_articles.title: Claims of being vishwaguru but can't conduct single exam: Rahul's dig at PM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress**, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for the delayed CUET-UG 2026 examination, alleging that the government has destroyed the education system.  He accused **Modi** of being unable to conduct even a single examination properly despite claiming to be a "vishwaguru." **Gandhi** stated that this failure is impacting millions of students and will hold **Modi** accountable for his actions.

recent_articles.title: Former Kozhikode Mayor and senior CPI(M) leader T.P. Dasan passes away - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **T.P. Dasan**, a former **Kozhikode Mayor** and prominent Communist Party of India (Marxist) leader, has passed away at the age of 76.  He was admitted to a private hospital in Kozhikode city on Friday night after his condition worsened and died on Saturday evening.  Dasan served as the Mayor of Kozhikode from 1992 to 1994 and held other positions within the **CPI(M)**, including chairing the corporation's standing committee on city development. He was also a member of the party’s district secretariat for many years.

recent_articles.title: ‘Technical glitch’ delays CUET-UG 2026 exam at some centres - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** announced a delay of over two hours for the first shift of the Common University Entrance Test-Undergraduate (CUET-UG) on Saturday, May 30, 2026, due to technical glitches at some examination centres. **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** was blamed for the delay, which affected candidates across different states. The NTA stated that the issue has been resolved and compensatory time will be provided to all candidates.  The second shift of the exam was also revised with entry starting at 1 p.m. and the examination beginning at 4 p.m.

recent_articles.title: Vizhinjam seaport in Kerala becomes fastest Indian port to handle 2 million TEUs cargo in 18 months - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vizhinjam International Seaport** in Kerala has achieved a significant milestone by handling 20 lakh TEUs of cargo in just 18 months, nearly twice its annual capacity. The port, developed and operated by **Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd.** (APSEZ) for the Kerala government, is now the first Indian port to achieve this feat.  The port's strategic location along the Indian Ocean corridor and deep draft capabilities make it a competitive transshipment destination in the region, attracting large container vessels like MSC Irina and MSC Verona. **Vizhinjam** is also expected to handle more cargo with its second phase expansion, which will be completed by 2028.

recent_articles.title: Government defends Farmer Discom proposal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana Rural Power Distribution Company Limited (TGRPDCL)** Chairman and Managing Director Musharraf Ali Faruqui stated that no metering would be introduced for agricultural consumers under the proposed Farmer Discom model. **The TGRPDCL** argued that existing discoms in Telangana are financially stressed, with accumulated losses reaching ₹69,741 crore by FY 2025, and operational inefficiencies contribute to high AT&C losses of 19.84% in FY 2025. The proposed model aims to improve electricity distribution and reliability for farmers while focusing on improving service quality and reducing technical and commercial losses.
